newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian sugar beet, sunseed sowings fall yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Russian sugar beet, sunseed sowings fall yr/yr.

text.p: Russia's 1997 sugar beet sowings are down 19.6 percent on 1996 levels, while sunflowerseed plantings are 9.5 percent below last year's hectarage, State Statistics Committee figures showed on Tuesday.
The area sown to beets for harvesting this year was 965,000 square hectares, compared to 1.2 million in 1996.
The area sown to sunseeds was 3.44 million hectares, below year-ago levels of 3.8 million. Sowing of both crops has ended.
Russia has officially forecast sugarbeet output at 22 million tonnes this year, above last year's 16.1 million. Some officials have said the target is unrealistic.
Officials have not yet said how sunseed output might improve on last year's poor 2.75 million tonnes, and independent analysts say the size of the crop will be predictable only later in the summer.
